integrity: The analytical proof establishes the uniform theorem. Independent mathematical verification and publication-priority certification have not been performed; numerical tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only first O(p) positive real zeros for p growing; no assertion for fixed-p remote or complex zeros, nor uniform C as C grows. Closest sources use fixed-exponent large-frequency asymptotics. Older literature may contain unindexed equivalents.
title: Gamma-phase crossover for super-Gaussian Fourier zeros
